title: Set an alarm
aliases: how do i set an alarm
wake me up in the morning
put an alarm on my phone
make my phone ring at a set time

steps.instruction: Set the hour with the hour wheel.
Set the minutes with the minute wheel.
Set the time-of-day wheel to "AM" for morning or "PM" for afternoon or evening, if shown.
Check that the time shows morning or afternoon as you intended. A 24-hour clock has no "AM" or "PM".
Tap the tick icon to save the alarm.

source_note: Clock on iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. Sets a regular alarm, not a sleep schedule. The time controls depend on 12-hour or 24-hour settings; confirm the wheels and save icon. Some earlier layouts say Alarm or Save instead of Alarms or a tick icon. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/iph2909d3a74/27/ios/27
